items.prompt: Why use price<other.price rather than price<=other.price for sorting?

options.why: No such valid ordering guarantee follows.
An item must not compare before itself.

options.text: Equal prices must be deleted before any sort
options.why: Equivalent keys can remain as separate records.
Algorithm stability does not fix an invalid comparator.

items.explanation: For integer keys, < satisfies the ordering structure; <= violates irreflexivity and the comparison requirements.
